body:
You probably should call `notifyListeners(l -> l.onExecuteToolError(context, cause))` before throwing this exception because otherwise, the listeners won't get notified (you call it a few lines later, but if you throw an exception here, that code won't be reached). 

It would be nice to have this covered by a test if possible too (both for server-cancelled and client-cancelled operations), because if there is a listener that pairs requests with responses/errors, then it will leak an entry per cancelled call, so this potentially even opens up a security (DoS) issue where a malicious server deliberately cancels operations to cause memory leaks.
